verdict.rationale: The evidence shows California SOS publishes fixed turnaround guarantees for paid expedite tiers (24-hour, same-day, 4-hour drop-off) and says certificates of status are available within minutes online. Those are static service-level promises, not current processing times for a founder's transaction type. No evidence shows the service publishing live or current standard processing times or backlog status, so this is adjacent support only and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
